title: Half of Voters Dislike Socialism Amid Progressive Wins, New Poll Finds
summary: Zohran Mamdani, the New York City mayor and democratic socialist, was viewed more favorably than Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, a fellow high-profile member of the movement.
